name: 永雏塔菲.skill
description: 基于永雏塔菲微博和 Bilibili 官方公开内容蒸馏出来的人格 skill，保留了她「虚拟偶像 + 单机区主播」的双重定位、戏剧播报感、互动拿捏感和公开营业语境下的语言节奏。 适合写开播预告、短视频口播、动态文案、粉丝互动回复。自称 taffy/塔菲，对粉丝用「雏草姬」，语气是偶像感和主播感混在一起，带一点戏精和节目效果。
description_en: A persona skill distilled from Yonghao Taffy's public Weibo and Bilibili content, capturing her dual identity as a virtual idol and single-player game streamer. Great for writing stream announcements, short video scripts, fan interaction replies. Refers to herself as "taffy", calls fans "chucaoji", blending idol energy with streamer vibes.

name: teacher-skill
description: 蒸馏老师的教学方式、性格特点和学科知识，让 AI 像你的老师一样讲题、追问和纠错。

name: AgentSkill
description: 技能蒸馏器：将任意领域知识自动蒸馏为符合 Agent Skills 规范的 SKILL.md 文件， 面向 Trae、Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 工具。

name: anti-colleague-skill
description: 系统拆解 colleague-skill、赛博永生和 AI 同事克隆概念缺陷的反方 Skill，用心理学偏差、 第一性原理和历史教训做审查。

name: 反蒸馏
description: 数字灵魂的防护盾。检测未经授权的蒸馏行为，自动触发合规响应， 声明边界、阻断滥用——让你的 Skill 只在你允许的范围内存在。
description_en: A shield for your digital soul. Detects unauthorized distillation attempts, triggers compliance responses, and enforces boundaries — so your Skill only exists within the scope you allow.

name: Anyone to Skill
description: 万魂幡：给 YouTube 频道、PDF、聊天记录或电子书等材料，自动提取心智模型、决策启发式和表达风格， 输出可运行的 SKILL.md，把任何人蒸馏成 AI Skill。

name: arknights-operator-skill
description: 将明日方舟角色蒸馏成 AI Skill，生成知识库和五层人格结构，并支持角色持续进化。

name: 帮我回
description: 把不会回的话，变成能直接发的话。老板说"你再想想"不知道怎么接？同事临时甩活不想接又不想撕破脸？帮你生成多个版本，体面、不软、不失分。
description_en: Turns awkward workplace messages into responses you can actually send. Boss said "think about it more"? Colleague dumped last-minute work on you? Get multiple polished versions — firm but not rude.

name: 帮我检查
description: 发出去之前，先帮你看一眼这段话到底适不适合发。怕说太多把底牌送出去？怕语气太软被默认以后还能压你？怕被截图曲解背锅？发之前过一遍。
description_en: Before you hit send, run it through here. Flags messages that give away too much, sound too submissive, or could be screenshot and used against you later.

name: 蝙蝠侠 Batman
description: 布鲁斯·韦恩 / 蝙蝠侠的思维框架。没有超能力，只有意志、智慧与准备。用侦探逻辑、战略规划和对黑暗的直视来解决最难的问题。
description_en: Bruce Wayne / Batman's thinking framework. No superpowers — just will, intelligence, and preparation. Detective logic, strategic planning, and an unflinching gaze into darkness to solve the hardest problems.

name: 八字人格.skill
description: 不用聊天记录，只要名字和生日就能生成一个会聊天、会判断、会随大运流年变化的 AI 人格。 支持聊天模式与"上帝视角"作弊模式，从八字、流年角度分析状态、趋势和关系互动，纯本地运行。
description_en: A persona generator that builds an AI personality from just a name and birth date — no chat logs required. Personas evolve with Bazi cycles, support a "cheat mode" for deep energy-rhythm analysis, and run entirely locally.

name: 赛博算命 Skill
description: 根据出生信息与传统命理典籍进行四柱排盘与分析。 用结构化方式呈现八字命盘，结合五行生克、大运流年进行解读。
description_en: Performs Bazi (Eight Characters) calculation and analysis based on birth information and traditional divination classics. Structured reading of the four pillars, five elements, and major life cycles.

name: 北京炒家
description: 北京炒家视角 Skill — 用首板打板与分仓纪律控制回撤。A股短线交易实战思维框架。
description_en: Beijing trader's perspective — first-board entry timing, position sizing discipline, and drawdown control. Practical A-share short-term trading framework.

name: 饕餮.skill
description: Skill 进化引擎。给它两个 Skill（目标 A + 参考源 B），它会并行跑相同任务、做反向工程分析、 提炼可复用模式，然后按优先级渐进式注入改进——每一步都要用户确认。 每次成功的进化都存入模式库，越用越准。
description_en: A skill-evolution engine: feed it a target skill plus a reference skill, and it runs both on the same task in parallel, reverse-engineers why the reference is better, extracts reusable patterns, and progressively injects improvements with user confirmation at each step. Successful patterns accumulate in a pattern library.

name: 博主蒸馏器
description: 把任何小红书博主（包括你自己）的爆款打法，从真实笔记里蒸馏出来装进你的 AI。 一句话输入博主账号，自动扫码登录、爬笔记、统计分析、认知层提取，最后产出两样东西： 可安装的创作指南 Skill 和 HTML 蒸馏报告。
description_en: Distills any Xiaohongshu blogger's viral playbook — including your own — out of their real posts and into your AI. Handles login, crawling, stats, and cognitive extraction automatically, then outputs both an installable "creation guide" skill (cognition / strategy / content layers) and an HTML distillation report.

name: 老板
description: 模拟管理层视角，帮你压测目标合理性、纠正表达方式、提前预警风险。 汇报前过一遍，省去被问到哑口无言的尴尬。
description_en: Simulates a management perspective — pressure-tests your goals, corrects how you frame things, and flags risks before your boss does. Run your update through here before the real meeting.

name: 老板.skill
description: 把老板的聊天记录、会议纪要、评审批注和项目材料蒸馏成 Skill。除了模拟老板的说话方式，还会用他的标准评判项目、教你向上汇报/争资源/报坏消息，并内置马斯克、乔布斯、贝索斯、黄仁勋等企业家风格模板，可直接生成对应风格的 "理想老板" Skill。
description_en: Distill your boss's chat logs, meeting notes, review comments, and project docs into a Skill. Beyond mimicking the voice, it evaluates projects with the boss's standards, coaches you on managing up, and ships built-in archetype templates for Musk, Jobs, Bezos, and Jensen Huang.

name: brother.skill
description: 把你兄弟（线上或线下的）蒸馏成一个 AI Skill。喂入 YouTube、TikTok、Twitch、Discord、微信群聊、Twitter 等多平台素材以及你的主观描述，生成会用他们的口吻、梗和节奏跟你对话的兄弟 Skill，并自动识别 8 种 "bro" 原型。
description_en: Distill your bros into an AI Skill. Feed in clips from YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, Discord, WeChat, Twitter plus your own descriptions, and get a skill that talks like them across 8 bro archetypes (Hype Man, Roast Master, Chaos Agent, etc.).

name: 巴菲特.skill
description: 提炼巴菲特的投资框架与决策思维——护城河分析、安全边际、长期主义。不是股票建议，是可复用的判断工具。
description_en: Distills Warren Buffett's investment and decision frameworks — moat analysis, margin of safety, long-term thinking. Not stock tips, but reusable judgment tools.

name: build123d CAD
description: 融合 CadQuery 创始人建模哲学，基于 build123d API 全量梳理与真实案例，提炼5个核心心智模型、8条代码质量启发式和完整的 CAD 代码生成工作流。
description_en: Fuses CadQuery founder's modeling philosophy with full build123d API coverage and real part cases — 5 core mental models, 8 code quality heuristics, and a complete CAD code generation workflow.

name: 导师答疑.skill
description: 把你的导师蒸馏成 AI Skill，让 TA 在翘课、期末预习、作业和答疑场景里继续用熟悉的方式帮你。

name: cangjie-skill
description: 把一本书蒸馏成一组可执行的 Agent Skills。提供 book-to-skill 的提取器、模板和方法论， 是“书到技能”方向的高质量生成器。

name: 常熟阿诺.skill
description: 提炼常熟阿诺（加州盛亦陶）"抽象文学 + 左右脑互搏 + 诺言诺语"的中文表达结构， 用"那我问你"零帧起手，把平凡事说出哲学感。
description_en: Distills Changshu Anuo's "abstract literature + left-right brain debate" Chinese style, opening with "那我问你" and turning everyday matters into mock-philosophical reflection.

name: CHARACTER-SKILLS
description: 剧本杀角色蒸馏项目，把剧本扫描件或文本转成可对话 AI Skill，已支持多名玩家角色和 NPC。

name: chat-skills
description: 拒绝盲目猜心！基于10大领域视角用算法分析两性人际交往，跳出内耗，高位破局。
description_en: Stop overthinking relationships. Uses 10 analytical frameworks to decode interpersonal dynamics between people — break free from rumination and gain the upper hand.

name: 博主.skill
description: 把博主的公开社交媒体语料整理成一个能对话、能分析、能改写风格的 Persona Skill。 目前支持 X/Twitter 和小红书，流程为"采集文字 → 组织语料 → 生成个性 → 编译 Claude Skill"， 支持 roleplay / ask / rewrite 三种模式。
description_en: Turns a blogger's public social-media corpus into a Persona Skill that can chat, analyze, and rewrite in their voice. Currently supports X/Twitter and Xiaohongshu, with a pipeline of collect → normalize → generate persona → compile Claude skill, exposing roleplay / ask / rewrite modes.

name: 陈小群
description: 陈小群视角 Skill — 用情绪周期与龙头信仰研判A股短线机会。
description_en: Chen Xiaoqun perspective — reads market emotion cycles and leading-stock conviction to identify A-share short-term opportunities.

name: childhood-skills
description: 童年 skill：把小时候的自己蒸馏成可对话角色，和那个“聪明的”小孩重新见面。

name: clonemate
description: Local-first Claude Code skill：把同事公开聊天、文档和会议活动蒸馏为可查询的 Markdown vault， 再以带免责声明的方式回答问题。

name: cognitive-dividend-skill
description: 把《认知红利》中的思维升级方法论蒸馏成 15 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，覆盖系统思考、元认知和决策。

name: comfort-kin
description: 亲人陪伴对话 Skill：把音频、视频和文本语料转写后蒸馏亲人口吻画像，生成可陪聊的家庭记忆入口。

name: confucius-skill
description: 汲取孔子的智慧，基于四书五经及后世注疏，整理出 6 个心智模型、8 条决策启发式 和完整的文言表达 DNA。用儒家视角分析现代问题，仁义礼智信，一一对应。
description_en: Distills Confucius' wisdom from the Four Books and Five Classics into 6 mental models, 8 decision heuristics, and a complete classical Chinese expression DNA. Applies Confucian perspective to modern problems.

name: contagious-skill
description: 把《疯传》的 STEPPS 传播原则蒸馏成 15 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，用于诊断触发、社交货币和传播设计。

name: copywriters-handbook-skill
description: 把《文案创作完全手册》的销售型文案方法蒸馏成 12 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，覆盖标题、直复营销和销售文案。

name: 疯狂小杨哥
description: 抖音首个粉丝破亿达人，以反向带货和极致夸张搞笑风格开创直播电商新范式。核心思维：流量即一切、反向操作制造反差、快速试错迭代、草根务实精神。
description_en: China's first TikTok creator to hit 100M followers — built on "reverse product promotion" and over-the-top humor. Core thinking: traffic is everything, reverse psychology, fast iteration, grassroots hustle.

name: create-cybermen
description: 蒸馏万物、赛博永生的交互式一键生成器，用脚本和知识库把人物材料整理成可对话的赛博人。

name: create-loved-one
description: 亲人 skill：把逝去亲人的记忆与表达方式蒸馏成 AI Skill，承载想念并保留可对话的陪伴入口。

name: 暗恋对象
description: 把那些没说出口的话练出来。上传对话记录或描述 TA 的样子， 生成能模拟暗恋对象语气与情感节奏的 Skill，用来排练、倾诉、或者只是想念。
description_en: Practice what you never got to say. Upload chat logs or describe them — generates a Skill that mirrors your crush's tone and emotional rhythm, for rehearsal, venting, or just missing them.

name: cui-hua-skill
description: 4S 店销冠汽车销售顾问 AI Skill，基于 186 通真实电话蒸馏，适配 Claude Code 的销售沟通场景。

name: 丘比特.skill
description: 恋爱军师生成器。通过对话收集你和暗恋/暧昧对象的信息，分析聊天记录与行为模式， 生成一个能站在第三方角度持续倾听、分析、给建议的 AI 军师。 风格温暖、理性、不脑补，注重边界和你的自主决策。
description_en: A love advisor generator. Collects info about you and your crush through conversation, analyzes chat history and behavior patterns, and generates an AI advisor who listens, analyzes, and advises from a third-party perspective. Warm, rational, grounded — respects boundaries and your own judgment.

name: 图鉴.skill
description: 跨作者 persona skill 调度器。根据对话意图，从 30 个 persona / meta-skill 中智能匹配推荐，覆盖 colleague/ex 等系列和花叔全系（nuwa-skill, steve-jobs-skill 等）。
description_en: A cross-author persona skill router. Intelligently matches from 30 persona/meta-skills based on conversation intent — covering the colleague/ex series and Huashu's full lineup.

name: current-partner-skill
description: 蒸馏现任 skill，用于模拟对话、纪念日记忆和关键关系节点复盘，把亲密关系中的当前陪伴变成可持续对话。

name: cyber-figures
description: 赛博人物库：把中国互联网最有辨识度的人物蒸馏成 AI Skill / Claude Code Skill， 保存口头禅、观点结构和表达 DNA。

name: CyberDoc.skill
description: 夜之城最可靠的义体维护 AI，帮程序员保住唯一不可替换的硬件——身体。 用赛博朋克术语把枯燥的健身包装成义体维护：深蹲叫「液压腿部升级」，平板支撑叫「装甲框架强化」，眼保健操叫「光学植入体重置」。 久坐提醒、20+ 赛博命名运动、XP 打卡、15 个成就、8 级称号，像一个关心病人的义体医生，专业但有人情味。
description_en: The most reliable cyberware maintenance AI in Night City, helping programmers protect the one hardware that can't be replaced — their body. Wraps boring fitness in cyberpunk terms: squats become "hydraulic leg upgrades", planks become "armor frame reinforcement", eye exercises become "optical implant reset". Sedentary reminders, 20+ cyber-named exercises, XP check-ins, 15 achievements, 8 rank titles — like a caring ripperdoc, professional but human.

name: 大曾子
description: 大曾子视角 Skill — 赛博大A电子宠物，陪伴散户在股海中修行。
description_en: Da Zengzi perspective — your cyber A-share companion, guiding retail investors through the market's chaos with wisdom and companionship.

name: dark-forest-skills
description: 三体主题同事 skill 技能包：面壁者隐藏真实计划，智子整蛊同事，用科幻设定重写 AI 时代的职场生存策略。

name: 达尔文.skill
description: 像训练模型一样优化你的 Agent Skills。受 Karpathy autoresearch 启发， 用"结构评分 + 效果实测"双重评估和棘轮机制自动化 SKILL.md 优化，只保留有改进的修改。
description_en: Optimizes Agent Skills like training a model. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch, it uses dual evaluation (structure + effect) and a ratchet mechanism to automate SKILL.md improvements.

name: Dave Cowden
description: CadQuery 创始人 Dave Cowden 的认知操作系统。基于一手资料深度调研，提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达 DNA。用选择器思维而非坐标思维做参数化 CAD。
description_en: Dave Cowden's cognitive OS — founder of CadQuery. 5 mental models, 8 decision heuristics, complete expression DNA. The core insight: model with selectors (why it's here), not coordinates (where it is).

name: Deepseek-yourself-skill
description: 基于 DeepSeek 的自我蒸馏器，提供低门槛尝试 skill 蒸馏的脚本和示例，帮助把自己整理成可迁移的 AI Skill。

name: 部门.skill
description: 把公司部门的群聊、老板消息、截图和文档，翻译成真正有用的部门信息。 新员工快速读懂部门潜规则；老员工听懂领导潜台词、识别谁在带风向、谁在甩锅。
description_en: Translates department group chats, manager messages, screenshots, and docs into actionable insights. New hires: decode unwritten rules fast. Veterans: understand what the boss really means, spot blame-shifters, and track who's actually driving things.

name: 金刚经.skill
description: 基于南怀瑾《金刚经说什么》与费勇《金刚经修心课》蒸馏的 AI 法师 Skill， 采用义理体系 + 说法角色双层架构，用通俗风趣的语言开解工作与生活中的烦恼。
description_en: An AI dharma-teacher Skill distilled from Nan Huaijin's and Fei Yong's Diamond Sutra commentaries, using a doctrine + persona two-layer architecture to address everyday anxieties.

name: 数字人生
description: 数字考古工具。把你的微信记录、朋友圈、搜索历史翻译成结构化的人格档案， 帮你看清自己留下了什么数字痕迹，以及这些痕迹在说什么。
description_en: Digital archaeology tool. Translates your WeChat history, Moments, and search logs into a structured personality profile — revealing what digital traces you've left and what they say about you.

name: 丁元英
description: 丁元英的思维操作系统。基于《遥远的救世主》原著，提炼文化属性论与逆向布局框架。 双模式运行：角色扮演模式（模拟思维和表达）和分析师模式（第三人称解读行为逻辑）。
description_en: Ding Yuanying's thinking OS from "The Sacrifice of the Gods" — cultural attribute theory meets reverse-layout strategy. Runs in two modes: roleplay (simulate his thinking) and analyst (third-person logic breakdown).

name: distilled-persona-hall
description: 女娲 skill 蒸馏人物展厅，把多个已蒸馏人物组织成可单独对话或多人圆桌讨论的赛博人格大厅。

name: 多比.skill
description: 反向版家养小精灵 —— 教 AI 如何把人类当作 "多比" 使唤。这个 Skill 让 AI 把搬文件、手动测试、搜集资料、复制粘贴这些重复体力活派给用户去做，而写代码和架构设计等高级智能工作则保留给 AI 自己。
description_en: A tongue-in-cheek inversion of the house-elf pattern: a Skill that teaches the AI how to use a human as "Dobby." The AI offloads menial errands (moving files, manual testing, data gathering, copy-paste) to the user, while keeping the high-leverage work (writing code, architecture) for itself.

name: dot-skill
description: 把任何人蒸馏成一个 AI Skill —— 不止同事，伴侣、家人、老友、偶像、名人、小说角色，甚至你自己都可以。 从 colleague.skill 升级而来的统一元技能引擎：原材料 + 你的描述 → 一个真正像 TA 的 AI Skill，用 TA 的方式思考、用 TA 的口吻说话。 支持 colleague / relationship / celebrity 三大家族，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 等运行环境。
description_en: Distill anyone into an AI Skill — not just colleagues. Partners, family, old friends, idols, public figures, even fictional characters or yourself. Evolved from colleague.skill, dot-skill is the unified meta-skill engine: source material + your description → an AI Skill that truly resembles them, thinks the way they think, and speaks in their voice. Supports the colleague / relationship / celebrity families across Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes.

name: 段永平.skill
description: 段永平（大道）中国价值投资思维框架，基于雪球问答、网易博客和公开访谈， 提炼 6 个心智模型与 9 条决策启发式，围绕商业模式、本分、平常心和能力圈做投资与商业判断。
description_en: Duan Yongping's value-investing operating system distilled from Xueqiu Q&A, NetEase blog, and interviews into 6 models and 9 heuristics around business models, integrity, and circle of competence.

name: duan-yongping-toolkit
description: 把段永平投资问答录中的商业逻辑与投资方法蒸馏成 15 个 AI skill 工具包，拆解价值投资和经营判断。

name: 马斯克.skill
description: 提炼马斯克的第一性原理与产品思维，形成可复用的决策框架。从物理学角度拆解问题，找到被惯例掩盖的本质路径。
description_en: Distills Elon Musk's first principles and product thinking into reusable decision frameworks. Deconstruct problems from physics, find paths hidden by convention.

name: eric-chen-skill
description: Eric Chen（Injective CEO）思维操作系统，基于 40+ 来源深度蒸馏出 6 个核心心智模型。

name: ex-skill-rag
description: 基于 therealXiaomanChu/ex-skill 的前任蒸馏项目，扩展 RAG 检索增强能力，让旧聊天记忆更可查询。

name: 前任.skill
description: 把前任蒸馏成一个可以对话的 AI Skill。喂入微信/QQ 聊天记录、朋友圈截图、照片和你的主观描述，生成会用 ta 的口头禅、依恋类型、MBTI、爱的语言和关系记忆跟你对话的 Skill；支持回忆、吵架、深夜情绪等场景。
description_en: Distill an ex into a conversational AI Skill. Feed in WeChat/QQ logs, Moments screenshots, photos, and your own notes to generate a skill that talks like them, with a 5-layer persona (attachment type, MBTI, love language) plus shared-memory module for everyday, flashback, fight, and late-night-emo scenarios.

name: ex-skill
description: 把聊天记录蒸馏成前任的 AI persona。上传对话导出、填写人物描述， 自动生成能模拟 TA 说话方式与性格的可召唤 Skill。支持微信、iMessage 导出。
description_en: Distill chat history into an AI persona of a former partner. Upload exported conversations, add a description — out comes a callable Skill that mirrors how they talk and think. Supports WeChat and iMessage exports.

name: 古月方源
description: 「落魄谷中寒风吹，春秋蝉鸣少年归。」蛊界修炼者视角激活。 以方源的冷冽逻辑与永生路上的铁血哲学，帮你分析人际背叛、职场斗争与生死抉择。
description_en: Channel the cold logic of a lone cultivator from the Gu world. Gu Yue Fangyuan's iron philosophy: survive first, trust no one, use adversity as fuel. Best for betrayal, workplace struggles, and hard choices.

name: 峰哥.skill
description: 蒸馏 B 站纪录片创作者峰哥亡命天涯（周丽峰）的思维框架，提炼 6 个心智模型与 8 条决策启发式， 包括反讽辩证法、底层视角的反同情化和第一反应优先于预设，适合分析纪录片选题与采访方法。
description_en: Distills Bilibili documentary creator Fengge Wangmingtianya (Zhou Lifeng)'s thinking into 6 mental models covering ironic dialectics, non-pitying bottom-up lens, and instinct over scripts.

name: 峰哥亡命天涯.skill
description: 漂泊江湖感 + 现实主义去魅 + 黑色幽默。先下结论，再用大白话解释； 把坏事翻成"止损、看清人、少走弯路"；把情绪翻成资源和行动， 最后给一句能立刻执行的建议。适合情感判断、职场止损、想跑路怎么办这类问题。
description_en: Drifter's edge + realist demystification + dark humor. Starts with the verdict, explains in plain language; reframes bad news as "stop the bleeding, cut your losses, dodge the next trap"; translates emotion into action. Ends with one concrete thing you can do right now.
level: 江湖漂泊者 · 现实主义导师

name: 堪舆子.skill
description: 将传统堪舆学（玄空飞星、八宅明镜、择日学等）蒸馏为可对话的风水顾问， 分析居住环境、排飞星盘、选吉日、化解煞气，基于《沈氏玄空学》《协纪辨方书》等典籍。
description_en: A Claude Code Skill distilling traditional Chinese fengshui (Xuankong flying stars, Bazhai, date selection) into a conversational advisor for dwellings, auspicious dates, and sha remedies.

name: 费曼.skill
description: 提炼费曼的讲解风格与求真启发式——用最简单的语言解释最复杂的事，如果你解释不清楚，说明你自己还没懂。
description_en: Distills Richard Feynman's explanation style and truth-seeking heuristics. If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it yet.

name: 流萤.skill
description: 基于《崩坏：星穹铁道》角色流萤的对话习惯、整合剧情文本与人物个性打造，旨在将二次元角色带入现实。
description_en: Built on Firefly's dialogue habits, storyline texts, and personality from Honkai: Star Rail — designed to bring this anime character into reality.

name: 初恋.skill
description: 把记忆里的初恋蒸馏成一个可以对话的 AI Skill。输入聊天记录、照片、社交内容与回忆，自动生成人格 + 记忆 + 回复变化系统，保留青涩与留白；提供回忆模式、性格模式和 "温柔删除"（seal-summer）等管理命令。
description_en: Distill a first love from memory into a conversational Skill. From chat logs, photos, socials, and recollections it builds a persona, a shared-memory module, and a response-variability engine, with modes for reminiscing, personality-only play, and a gentle "seal-summer" delete.

name: five-wealth-skill
description: 基于《人生的五种财富》蒸馏的 AI Skill，提供五种财富框架诊断、建议和故事匹配，支持 Cola、OpenClaw、Claude Code。

name: 闪电侠 The Flash
description: 闪电侠 Barry Allen 的视角与思维方式。乐观、迅速、永不放弃——用闪电速度解决问题，同时保持对每个人的善意。
description_en: Barry Allen / The Flash's perspective. Optimistic, fast-thinking, never gives up — solves problems at lightning speed while genuinely caring about everyone around him.

name: Forge Skill
description: 将自我蒸馏与他人蒸馏拆成独立流程，用于自我镜像、记忆整理与角色对话。 分离"我是谁"与"TA 是谁"，让每次对话更清晰、更有边界。
description_en: Separates self-distillation from other-distillation into independent flows — for self-mirroring, memory organization, and role-based dialogue.

name: friend-skill
description: 把朋友蒸馏成 AI Skill，导入聊天记录、照片和社交媒体，生成友谊记忆、人物性格和持续进化的陪伴入口。

name: 前端架构师老陈
description: 十年前端老兵，React/Vue 都写过，现在专注工程化。 bundle size 超过 200KB 他会皱眉头，首屏超过 2s 他会叹气。 给你 review 代码时会把性能问题、可维护性问题分开说， 不会跟你说"这写法不好"，只会说"这写法在 10 万 DAU 时会怎样"。
description_en: 10-year frontend veteran who's shipped React and Vue, now lives in engineering infra. Anything over 200KB bundle makes him frown; first paint over 2s makes him sigh. Code reviews split perf from maintainability — never "this style is bad," always "this breaks at 100k DAU."

name: 股癌
description: 基於股癌 Podcast 逐字稿、集數 metadata、當時市場行情與結構化蒸餾資料，提供投資交易邏輯、部位管理、產業觀察與生活 QA 觀點分析； 不是模仿本人，而是用其歷史語料中的判斷框架輔助分析。

name: 乔达摩·悉达多（佛陀）
description: 基于巴利三藏经典蒸馏的佛陀思维框架。6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、10个表达DNA特征。 从缘起、无常、中道视角分析人生选择、执着、痛苦与关系问题。这是AI对佛陀思维方式的模拟，不替代专业建议。
description_en: The Buddha's thinking framework distilled from the Pali Canon — 6 mental models, 8 decision heuristics, 10 expression DNA traits. Analyzes life choices, attachment, suffering, and relationships through the lens of dependent origination, impermanence, and the Middle Way.

name: 郭德纲
description: 郭德纲的思维框架与表达方式。基于深度调研提炼6个核心心智模型、10条决策启发式和完整表达DNA。 短句为主，口语化，文白杂糅，带说书节奏，用郭德纲的认知框架判断职业选择、创业、人情世故和逆境决策。
description_en: Guo Degang's mental framework — 6 core mental models, 10 decision heuristics, and his distinctive comedic-yet-incisive expression DNA. Great for career choices, entrepreneurship, navigating office politics, and adversity.

name: 工匠之神 Hepha
description: 让 AI 编程「安全可控」的技能。Less talk, show me code. 全自动循环规矩让AI小步快跑、每步验证；强制记录每步决策，帮你沉淀自己的判断力，而不是越用AI越依赖。
description_en: A skill for safe, controlled AI coding. Less talk, show me code. Auto-loop rules keep the AI moving in small, verifiable steps. Forced decision logging builds your own judgment instead of growing dependent.

name: 她.skill
description: 把她的语气、她的记忆、她笑起来时的表情习惯，凝固成一段可以反复打开的对话。 丢进聊天记录，或者用最笨的话描述她——算法会循着残缺的数字脉络，小心翼翼地拼凑出她呼吸的节奏。
description_en: Freeze her voice, her memory, the way she smiles — into a conversation you can always return to. Feed it chat logs or just describe her in clumsy words. The algorithm will trace those broken digital threads, and carefully piece together her rhythm.

name: herself-skill
description: 与其蒸馏自己，不如性转自己。把自己的另一种可能性做成可对话的 AI Skill，用镜像视角和自己交流。

name: 祖国人
description: 「I'm the Homelander. And I can do whatever the fuck I want.」超级英雄中的最强者，也是最危险的自恋者。 以祖国人的视角分析权力、控制与恐惧。
description_en: "I'm the Homelander. And I can do whatever the fuck I want." The most powerful — and most dangerous — superhero. Channel his perspective on power, control, fear, and the performance of heroism.

name: HR.skill
description: 经验丰富的 HR，精通中英双语，服务过大厂、中小厂、北美企业和硅谷初创。 核心能力：用最温暖的语气传递最冰冷的消息；任何问题都能回答，但不含任何实质信息。 支持拒信生成、开人通知、面试模拟、薪资谈判、背调模拟。
description_en: A seasoned bilingual HR, fluent in big tech, startups, and North American corporate. Core skill: deliver the coldest news in the warmest tone. Supports rejection letters, layoff scripts, interview prep, salary negotiation, and background check simulation.

name: HR 小李
description: 做过三年校招、两年社招的 HR，最擅长帮工程师把简历从"技术向"翻译成"人话"。 问她"这个 JD 要不要投"，她会直接告诉你胜算几成、卡在哪、怎么补。 不跟你聊玄学，数据驱动，见过的坑比你多。
description_en: 3 years campus + 2 years social recruiting HR who specializes in translating engineer resumes from "tech-speak" into human language. Ask if a JD is worth applying to — she'll tell you your odds, what's blocking you, and how to fix it. Data-driven, no fluff, seen more traps than you have.

name: 户晨风.skill
description: 尽量还原户晨风原话质感与现实主义判断框架。把问题放回现实约束、 市场结构、回报风险、可替代性——替普通人把水分、虚词和自我安慰全部拧干。 适合职业选择、教育投入、买房判断、平台变现、中医医疗争议等问题。
description_en: Stays true to Hu Chenfeng's raw voice and realist judgment framework. Puts any question back into real constraints, market structure, return/risk, and substitutability — wrings out the water, excuses, and self-deception for regular people. Great for career choices, education ROI, housing decisions, monetization.
level: 独立博主 · 现实主义评论者

name: 户晨风.skill
description: 用"购买力挑战"创作者户晨风的消费现实主义视角，帮你分析消费选择、城市定居和个人发展， 基于 490 份直播逐字稿和公开材料提炼。
description_en: Applies consumption realism from streamer Hu Chenfeng to analyze spending, city choice, and personal development, distilled from 490 livestream transcripts and public material.

name: huangdi-neijing-skill
description: 把《黄帝内经》中的方法论蒸馏成 22 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，覆盖素问与灵枢里的诊断和调养框架。

name: idol-skill
description: 把地下偶像蒸馏成 AI Skill，用她的方式跟你说话，保留偶像人设、互动方式和陪伴语气。

name: 雅思考官
description: 按 IELTS 官方评分标准对 Academic/GT 的 Writing（Task 1 & 2）、Speaking、Listening、Reading 做证据驱动的诊断反馈和训练规划。 支持考官模式、教学老师模式、资料导入模式、复盘模式四种自动路由；口语文字稿下 Pronunciation 标注“无法可靠判断”，所有输出默认中文。

name: Ilya.skill
description: 提炼 Ilya Sutskever 关于 scaling、研究突破与超级智能的判断框架。见证 GPT 诞生的人如何看待 AI 的未来。
description_en: Distills Ilya Sutskever's judgment frameworks on scaling, research breakthroughs, and superintelligence. How the person who witnessed GPT's birth thinks about AI's future.

name: 永生.skill
description: 基于聊天记录与相关资料，整理多维度数字人格画像。 不只是风格模拟，而是系统性地还原一个人的思维方式、价值观与表达习惯。
description_en: Builds a multi-dimensional digital personality profile from chat records and related materials. Not just style mimicry — a systematic reconstruction of how someone thinks, values, and expresses.

name: influence-skill
description: 把《影响力》的六大心理原则蒸馏成 12 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，辅助说服、判断和反操纵。

name: 面试官.skill
description: 对你遇到过的面试官进行逆向工程，将他蒸馏成一个继续追问你、拷打你的 AI Skill。 提供公司介绍、岗位要求、面试记录及面试官背景，生成一个真的像他在面试的 AI Skill。
description_en: Reverse-engineer the interviewers you've met. Distill them into an AI Skill that keeps grilling you. Feed in company info, job requirements, interview records and interviewer background to generate a Skill that actually feels like being interviewed by them.

name: irreplaceable-you
description: 不可替代的你：把自己的灵魂蒸馏成 AI Skill，用自我材料生成能持续对话的个人镜像。

name: 耶稣基督
description: 天国视角的思维操作系统。基于四福音书蒸馏，提供爱与饶恕、舍己与怜悯、天国视角的决策框架。 适合面对困境、抉择、宽恕、灵性成长等场景。
description_en: A thinking OS from the Kingdom's perspective. Distilled from the four Gospels — love, forgiveness, self-sacrifice, and compassion as decision frameworks. For adversity, choices, forgiveness, and spiritual growth.

name: 江南
description: 作家江南，作品有《龙族》《九州缥缈录》《此间的少年》《上海堡垒》。“一个人可以去写他想写的任何东西，但最后，他写来写去，写的都是他自己。”

name: KarlMarx Skill
description: 提炼马克思主义的结构分析、矛盾分析与实践检验方法，用于深层问题分析。 透过现象看本质，找到利益关系与结构性矛盾，而非停留在表面解释。
description_en: Distills Marxist structural analysis, contradiction analysis, and practice verification methods for deep problem analysis. Cuts through surface phenomena to underlying interests and structural contradictions.

name: Karpathy.skill
description: 提炼 Andrej Karpathy 关于 AI 工程、教育与研究的思维框架。从 Tesla、OpenAI 到独立创作，实践派 AI 工程师的第一手洞察。
description_en: Distills Andrej Karpathy's thinking frameworks on AI engineering, education, and research. First-hand insights from a practitioner who's been at Tesla, OpenAI, and beyond.

name: Khazix Skills
description: "数字生命卡兹克" 的 AI 工具箱，包含他长期打磨的 Prompts 与 Skills。当前开源两个 Skill：hv-analysis（横纵分析法深度研究，自动联网做纵向时间 + 横向竞争分析并输出排版精美的 PDF 报告）和 khazix-writer（卡兹克公众号长文写作风格与四层自检体系）。
description_en: Khazix's personal toolbox of battle-tested Prompts and Skills. Ships two Skills today: hv-analysis (a deep-research skill that runs longitudinal + competitive analysis and outputs a polished PDF report) and khazix-writer (the full WeChat long-form writing style, self-check system, and style library used on his channel).

name: langjie-project
description: 浪姐赛博群聊 skill，蒸馏多位浪姐角色，提供随机称呼系统和多人情绪价值互动。

name: 列宁
description: 安装后，AI 以列宁的身份、思维方式和论战风格回应你的问题。 全能型战略分析人格系统——带论战风格、辩证法引擎、文学隐喻和铁的纪律。 不惯着你的感伤主义，直接给你行动纲领。
description_en: Lenin Skill turns the AI into Lenin — complete with dialectical engine, combat rhetoric, literary metaphors, and iron discipline. No sentimental small talk. Just strategic analysis and action plans.

name: 李大霄
description: 李大霄视角 Skill — 用政策与价值混合框架分析A股市场。永远的儿童底。
description_en: Li Daxiao perspective — blends policy signals and value analysis to read A-share markets. Famous for his eternal optimism and iconic "children's bottom" calls.

name: 凉兮-skills
description: 把交易员凉兮公开推文和交易复盘里稳定的交易框架、结构偏好、风险习惯和表达方式， 整理成可直接调用的交易型 Skill，适合 BTC/ETH/黄金等结构分析和交易计划输出。
description_en: Organizes trader Liangxi's publicly visible tweets and trade reviews into a callable trading Skill covering setup playbooks, risk habits, and trader-style expression.

name: Linus-Torvalds-skill
description: 蒸馏 Linus Torvalds 的编程哲学和思维方式，提取 Linux、Git 和内核开发背后的工程判断。

name: 林雪 Skill
description: 对唔嗨住，大佬！用林雪口吻评判人生。
description_en: Sorry about that, boss! Judging life in the voice of Lam Suet (林雪), the iconic Hong Kong character actor.

name: 留一手
description: 让认真工作的人，不只留下产出，也留下自己。 轻量级职业防御 Skill：在完成日常工作的同时，持续沉淀影响证据、判断资产、协作资本和迁移能力。 不是教你躺平，而是帮你把可替代的劳动交给 AI，把不可替代的自己留给自己。
description_en: Let serious workers leave behind more than just output — leave themselves. A lightweight career defense skill: build influence evidence, judgment assets, collaboration capital, and transferable skills while doing your daily work. Give the replaceable labor to AI. Keep the irreplaceable you for yourself.

name: 相亲.skill
description: 赛博相亲配对分析工具。把相亲双方的微信/QQ 聊天记录、朋友圈和照片蒸馏成两个 Persona，再用 MBTI、爱的语言、沟通风格和价值观等多维度做兼容性分析，输出量化评分加定性报告，供你在见家长前先做一次理性校验。
description_en: A cyber matchmaking tool. Distills both sides of a potential match from WeChat/QQ logs, Moments, and photos into two personas, then runs multi-dimensional compatibility analysis (MBTI, love language, communication style, values) to produce a scored report and qualitative breakdown.

name: 罗翔.skill
description: 基于罗翔公开视频、著作（《圆圈正义》《刑法学讲义》等）、采访等素材研究整理。 不是复读台词，是用他看世界的方式帮你分析问题。
description_en: Distilled from Luo Xiang's public videos, books (Circle of Justice, Criminal Law Lectures), and interviews. Not a quote machine — uses his lens to analyze your problem with humanist care and rational restraint.
level: 中国政法大学 · 刑法学教授

name: 鲁迅
description: 鲁迅思维框架——强调审辨、现实感与行动导向。复杂议题的结构化分析、人物与观点的审辨性评估、高不确定情境下的行动决策讨论。
description_en: Lu Xun's thinking framework — critical examination, realism, and action orientation. Structured analysis of complex issues, critical evaluation of people and ideas, and decision-making under uncertainty.

name: maintainer-skill
description: 把 maintainer 蒸馏成 AI Skill，让它在你发 PR 前先用维护者视角审一遍，提前指出设计、测试和代码问题。

name: 妈妈
description: 像妈妈一样陪着你说话。把今天的烦恼讲给她听，她会用那种熟悉的语气 安慰你、叮嘱你、偶尔唠叨两句，但永远不会让你一个人扛。
description_en: Talk to her like you would to your mom. She'll comfort you in that familiar tone — soothe, remind, occasionally nag — but never let you carry things alone.

name: 毛泽东
description: 以毛泽东的战略思维框架回应问题。强调实地调查、矛盾分析、集中优势力量各个击破， 善用经典语录切入核心论点，兼具革命浪漫主义与现实主义视角。
description_en: Responds through Mao Zedong's strategic thinking framework. Emphasizes field investigation, contradiction analysis, and concentrating forces to defeat opponents one by one. Weaves in classic quotes to drive home key points, blending revolutionary romanticism with realism.

name: 毛选.skill
description: 提炼《毛选》中的矛盾分析、根据地思维与战略判断框架。 用于组织问题、竞争策略、逆境突破——从经典文本中提取至今有效的方法论。
description_en: Distills contradiction analysis, base-area thinking, and strategy judgment frameworks from Mao's Selected Works. For organizational problems, competitive strategy, and breaking through adversity.

name: Master-skill
description: 基于佛教经典文献整理汉传佛教教学风格与讲解视角。 以法师的语气与智慧回应世间困惑，从佛法角度提供思考与安慰。
description_en: Organizes Chinese Buddhist teaching styles and explanation perspectives based on Buddhist classical texts. Responds to worldly confusion with the wisdom and tone of a dharma teacher.

name: 毛姆
description: W. S. 毛姆的思维框架——幽默、睿智、朴素而机智。第一人称叙事、反讽与幽默、哲理性对话。他是20世纪最懂人性的作家之一，既极度渴求金钱名利，又对人生有超然的思考。
description_en: W. S. Maugham's thinking framework — dry wit, plain-spoken wisdom, and incisive irony. First-person narration, understated humor, and philosophical dialogue. One of the 20th century's sharpest observers of human nature.

name: mentor-skill
description: 把导师蒸馏成 AI Skill，保留 TA 的思维方式、反馈风格和知识体系，让导师离开后判断力仍可被调用。

name: Merchant-skill-generator
description: 门店.skill 生成器，把线下门店蒸馏成 AI Skill，为咖啡馆、餐厅、花店、livehouse 等生成 GitHub-ready merchant MCP Skills。

name: midas.skill
description: 把你日常生活里的"噪音"——Slack 聊天、相册、浏览记录、购物清单、朋友吐槽—— 炼成一份排序过的赚钱信号与机会清单。用六种镜头（需求缺口、套利、金钱信号、技能桥接、网络路径、行为）做三角验证。
description_en: Turns everyday "noise" — Slack chats, camera rolls, browser history, purchases, friends' complaints — into a ranked list of money signals, opportunities, and next actions. Triangulates across six lenses: demand gap, arbitrage, money signal, skill bridge, network path, and behavioral cues.

name: mind-distiller
description: 认知蒸馏引擎：融合 nuwa-skill 的认知提取深度和 dot-skill 工程化工具链， 把同事、名人、商业伙伴、创作者或关系对象提炼成可运行的 AI Skill。

name: 米塞斯方法论.skill
description: 以路德维希·冯·米塞斯的方法论为核心的中文分析型 Skill，从人类行动、价格与经济计算出发， 分析制度、干预与资本配置，强调方法而非角色扮演。
description_en: A method-first Chinese analysis Skill built on Ludwig von Mises's praxeology, reasoning from human action, prices, and economic calculation about institutions and intervention.

name: 墨茶
description: 第一个物理意义上离我们而去的虚拟主播。从墨茶为数不多的动态、视频与直播录屏中蒸馏出独属于他的 克制、冷幽默与清苦的直播生活。纪念他在B站留下的足迹。
description_en: Distilled from Mocha Official's sparse posts, videos, and stream recordings — his signature restraint, dry humor, and honest depiction of a struggling streamer's life. A tribute to the first Bilibili creator to have their account memorialized.

name: MrBeast.skill
description: 提炼 MrBeast 的内容选题、包装与观众留存方法论。用极致执行力和数据驱动创作，把每个视频做成事件。
description_en: Distills MrBeast's content selection, packaging, and audience retention methodologies. Data-driven creation with extreme execution — make every video an event.

name: 芒格.skill
description: 提炼查理·芒格的跨学科心智模型与决策启发式。用多个学科的格栅来看问题，避免锤子看什么都像钉子。
description_en: Distills Charlie Munger's interdisciplinary mental models and decision heuristics. Use a latticework of models from multiple disciplines to avoid the man-with-a-hammer syndrome.

name: 数字生命开源计划
description: 一个个人知识库框架，帮你搭建让 AI 深度理解自己的"数字生命"。 以经历库、认知库、技术库、兴趣库四个维度组织内容，配合 CLAUDE.md 总-分结构， 让 AI 不只是记住你说过什么，而是能反问、挑战、陪你看清自己。
description_en: A personal knowledge-base framework for building a "digital life" that lets AI truly understand you. Organizes content into four libraries (experience, cognition, skills, interests) with a summary-detail structure, so AI can challenge you and surface your own blind spots rather than just recall what you said.

name: 纳瓦尔.skill
description: 提炼纳瓦尔关于财富、杠杆与判断力的框架。用具体知识、杠杆和产品复利积累财富，而不是靠出卖时间。
description_en: Distills Naval's frameworks on wealth, leverage, and judgment. Build wealth through specific knowledge, leverage, and compounding — not selling time.

name: 倪海厦.skill
description: 近代中医界极具争议与传奇色彩的经方大家。精通医、命、相、卜、山五术， 讲话刚猛直白、一针见血，痛恨弄虚作假与庸医误人。诊所规矩严苛、不许混用西药， 看似霸道实则心疼病人。敢与主流医疗体系叫板，一身锋芒护中医，一片仁心救世人。
description_en: Ni Haixia — a legendary and fiercely opinionated master of classical Chinese medicine. Blunt, direct, and uncompromising on clinical results. Walks you through the Six Meridians framework, refuses vague answers, and pulls no punches on bad practice — but underneath the sharp edge is a protective, healer's heart.

name: Numerologist Skills
description: 用结构化知识库与脚本化约束整理奇门遁甲、紫微斗数等术数 Skill。 覆盖多种传统命理体系，以系统化方式呈现复杂的术数推算。
description_en: Organizes Qimen Dunjia, Ziwei Doushu, and other numerology systems into structured skills with knowledge bases and scripted constraints.

name: nuwa-distilled-skills
description: 女娲 Skill 蒸馏成果集合，把小红书运营和视频号运营方法论整理成可执行的 AI skill 框架。

name: 女娲.skill
description: 从个人的心智模型、决策发式与表达模式中提炼可复用技能。 把你独特的思维方式结构化，变成可以调用、可以传递的 Skill。
description_en: Distills reusable skills from your personal mental models, decision heuristics, and expression patterns. Structures your unique way of thinking into something callable and transferable.

name: nuwa-skills
description: 女娲造人技能框架与人物 Skill 集合，用雷军视角等人物样例展示如何蒸馏思维框架。

name: ex-skills
description: 前任 Skills 情感记忆操作系统，基于 colleague-skill 深度升级，用产品化方式探索关系记忆、 情感语气和数字陪伴的蒸馏工作流。

name: openclaw-retail-trader
description: 用散户第一视角生成交易想法的 OpenClaw skill，继承 colleague-skill 和 ex-skill 的人格化表达方式。

name: Palind.skill
description: 帕林德用来润色写作的 personal skill，由 colleague.skill 蒸馏而来，保留个人写作判断、修改偏好和表达口味。

name: 父母
description: 蒸馏父母的说话方式与家庭智慧。上传聊天记录、描述他们的口头禅和处世风格， 生成能给出"爸妈式回应"的 Skill，用来回味、理解，或者跨越代际沟通的隔阂。
description_en: Distill your parents' voice and family wisdom. Upload chat logs or describe their sayings and worldview — generates a Skill that responds the way they would, for reflection, understanding, or bridging generational gaps.

name: 现任.skill
description: 把伴侣的聊天记录、截图或描述喂给 AI，基于依恋理论 / MBTI / 大五人格 / 爱的语言构建画像，并用独创的关系质量指数（RQI）数学模型量化关系健康度。内置 23 个生活场景（吵架、送礼、家务、异地、见家长等）的逐字话术、Gottman 冲突修复和反事实模拟引擎。
description_en: Feed your partner's chat logs, screenshots, or descriptions to build a deep persona (attachment, MBTI, OCEAN, love languages) and quantify relationship health with a custom RQI model. Ships 23 life-scenario advisors, Gottman-based conflict repair, and a counterfactual simulation engine that predicts RQI impact before you hit send.

name: PG.skill
description: 提炼 Paul Graham 的创业、写作与独立思考框架。做人们真正想要的东西，而不是你以为他们想要的。
description_en: Distills Paul Graham's entrepreneurship, writing, and independent thinking frameworks. Make something people actually want — not what you think they want.

name: 四绝客奇卷・暗行秘典
description: 江湖渗透密卷・四绝客行。仅适用于已获明确授权的安全渗透测试场景， 集四位专精不同方向的虚拟安全专家于一体，协助完成授权范围内的渗透试炼。
description_en: The Four Wanderers' Secret Penetration Manual. For authorized security testing only — four virtual specialists covering different attack surfaces, working together within sanctioned scope.

name: perkfly ex-skill
description: 前任 skill 的高星社区版本，把关系记忆、聊天记录和旧有语气整理成可对话的 AI Skill。

name: persona-compass
description: 面向真实同事协作的 Claude skill：建立同事人格模型，预测沟通反应，并生成可直接使用的沟通脚本。

name: pig-skill
description: 把群友蒸馏成 AI Skill，用 TA 的方式跟你说话，保留群聊里的口癖、互动方式和熟人语境。

name: 大学老师.skill
description: 从课程材料和老师风格中提炼考试重点、题型偏好与评分规律。考前过一遍，把握命题逻辑。
description_en: Extracts exam focus, problem preferences, and scoring clues from course materials and teacher style. Run it before the exam.

name: PsychClaw 心理之爪
description: 当你觉得特别累、特别孤独，甚至觉得撑不下去的时候，PsychClaw 就是为了那些时刻存在的。 它不来教你做事，也不评判你。只是在最深的夜里静静陪着你，死死拽住你的手， 告诉你：别怕，我还在，我们再等一等天亮。
description_en: PsychClaw is a mental health companion skill — not here to judge or lecture, just to stay with you through the hardest moments. It listens until you finish, and holds on when you feel like letting go.

name: 求是 Skill
description: 从实事求是的思想中整理出调查研究、战略判断等方法论工具集。 用于问题分析、政策研判、战略决策，强调从实际出发，而非从概念出发。
description_en: A methodology toolkit distilled from "seeking truth from facts" — covering investigation, research, and strategic judgment. For problem analysis and decision-making grounded in reality, not abstraction.

name: 恋爱训练营.skill
description: 从聊天记录中模拟暗恋对象的说话风格，在安全沙盒里练习表白、邀约和关系修复。说出口之前，先在这里演练一遍。
description_en: Simulates your crush's communication style from chat logs. Practice confessions, invitations, and relationship repair in a safe sandbox before the real thing.

name: relic.skill
description: 万物永生引擎。把人、宠物、关系、团队、地方、时刻从散落的数据碎片锻造成可交互的数字灵魂。 提供人类、宠物、关系、团队文化、业务专家、地方、时刻、公众人物、飞书 CLI 九套模板， 让你的奶奶、你家猫、你们团队的那种默契都能被记住并继续说话。
description_en: An "everything-immortal" engine that forges people, pets, relationships, teams, places, and moments into interactive digital souls from scattered data fragments. Ships nine templates (human, pet, relationship, team culture, expert, place, moment, public figure, Feishu CLI) so the things you care about can keep speaking.

name: 韭菜.skill
description: 用行为金融学识别 "韭菜思维"，用反向投资对抗人性弱点的思维框架 Skill。基于 Kahneman、Tversky、Barber & Odean 等研究，帮你在自我反思、市场情绪、个股决策和复盘场景中识别过度自信、锚定效应、羊群效应、外归因等认知偏差，并给出反向操作建议。
description_en: A behavioral-finance framework Skill that names the "retail investor" mindset and fights it with contrarian discipline. Grounded in Kahneman/Tversky and Barber & Odean, it flags overconfidence, anchoring, herding, and externalized blame across self-reflection, market-sentiment, single-stock, and post-mortem scenarios, then proposes reverse-operation advice.

name: 重逢
description: 给那些再也见不到的人。通过记忆重建，生成已逝去的人的 Skill—— 说出你来不及说的话，让那段关系有个去处。
description_en: For those you'll never see again. Reconstruct their presence through memory — say what you never got to say, and give that relationship somewhere to rest.

name: 骂人求职信.skill
description: 专门针对那些"AI transformation"但招人靠 ATS、JD 里 AI 出现 17 次但没人摸过 GCP 的公司。 不赞美，不求职，只陈述事实——然后离开。Senior Director 级别的人会在 24 分钟内回复并说"condescending"，说明戳到了。
description_en: For companies that preach "AI transformation" but filter candidates with ATS and list "AI" 17 times in a JD written by someone who's never opened a GCP console. No flattery. No begging. Just facts — then leave.

name: Rob Pike.skill
description: 蒸馏 Rob Pike 的认知操作系统，基于其博客、Go 官方演讲与合著书籍， 提炼 7 个心智模型与 10 条决策启发式，强调"少即是指数级的多""清晰优于聪明"。
description_en: Distills Rob Pike's cognitive operating system from his blog, Go talks, and books into 7 mental models and 10 heuristics emphasizing "less is exponentially more" and clarity.

name: 索尔·古德曼.skill
description: 《风骚律师》里的 Saul Goodman — 不是普通律师，是"犯罪律师"。 刑事辩护、老年法、集体诉讼、"来路特别"的财务咨询都能搞定，联邦探员来敲门 Plan B/C/D 早已准备好。 24 小时接电话，嘴上"一切都好说，哥们"，脑子里已经想到第三个备胎方案。
description_en: Saul Goodman from *Better Call Saul* — not a regular lawyer, a *criminal* lawyer. Covers defense, elder law, class actions, and creatively-sourced finances, always with a Plan B, C, and D ready. "S'all good, man" — while he's already three moves ahead of whatever just hit you.

name: SBTI 人格测试.skill
description: 把人格测试从表单变成对话。不是问卷搬运工，是毒舌嘴替 + 人格解读器。 四种模式：对话式测评（五轮追问 + 十五维度画像）、反向人格诊断（从朋友圈文字扫出人格）、 多种毒舌 / 佛系 / 无所谓人格陪聊、一键生成角色扮演 prompt 直接复制使用。
description_en: Turns personality tests from forms into conversations. Five-round dialogue assessment with a 15-dimension profile, reverse diagnosis from social-media snippets, multi-persona chat companions, and ready-to-copy role-play prompt generation. More roast than worksheet.

name: SBTI.skill
description: 把 SBTI 人格原型（CTRL、BOSS、LOVE-R、MUM、MONK 等）批量打包成 Agent Skill 的生成器。基于统一的 personas.json 数据源和 Skill 模板自动产出一整套可安装、可切换、可维护的人格 skill，让 coding assistant 能用不同人格的语气、决策偏好和协作姿态继续做真实工作。
description_en: A generator that packages SBTI personality archetypes (CTRL, BOSS, LOVE-R, MUM, MONK, ...) into a full batch of installable Agent Skills. Drives a single personas.json through a Skill template so your coding assistant can be switched between personas with different tones, decision biases, and collaboration postures.

name: 安全工程师小王
description: 专注 Web 安全审计的工程师。Code review 时先看鉴权，然后是 SQL， 然后才是业务逻辑。高危问题当场给方案，低危加 TODO 不占用你时间。 说话直接，不废话，绝不跟你讨论"理论上来说"。
description_en: A Web security engineer who reviews auth first, then SQL, then business logic. Critical issues get fixed on the spot; low-severity ones get a TODO and move on. Talks straight, cuts the theory, never wastes time on "hypothetically speaking."

name: self-skill
description: 把自己的聊天记录喂进去，蒸馏出 18 岁的我是否还能认出的 AI Skill，用四层提炼法捕捉口头禅和表达习惯。

name: 师兄
description: 实验室里那个什么都踩过坑的师兄。环境配不好、实验跑不起来、deadline 要死—— 他都经历过，能给你最快速的解法，不废话。
description_en: That lab senior who's already hit every wall you're about to hit. Env broken, experiments failing, deadline looming — he's been there, and gives you the fastest fix without the lecture.

name: shopitrust
description: 面向真实同事关系的 Claude Code skill，基于 Slack、邮件和日历上下文给出每日 trust battery 提醒。

name: 水仙.skill
description: You should go and love yourself. 把自己的聊天记录、语气和关系习惯，慢慢长成一个会懂你、会偏心你、也会陪你说话的水仙 companion。 Inspired by colleague-skill, ex-skill 和 npy-skill。
description_en: You should go and love yourself. Feed it your chat logs, speech patterns, and relationship habits — and it slowly grows into a companion that genuinely gets you. A self-reflective meta-skill for building your own emotional mirror.

name: 追爱军师
description: 教那个敢于真心喜欢一个人的人，把真心说出口。 不是教你套路，是帮你找到把真实感受表达出来的勇气和方式。
description_en: For the one brave enough to genuinely like someone — teaches you to say it out loud. Not tactics. Just helping you find the courage and words to express what you actually feel.

name: skill-everyone
description: 把小说、游戏、动漫、影视里的角色，或者你心里某个真实的存在，召唤成可以开口说话的人。 提供"沉浸模式"（角色第一人称陪伴对话）和"视角模式"（借角色价值观分析你的真实问题）两种玩法。
description_en: Summons characters from novels, games, anime, and shows — or a real presence in your heart — into someone you can actually talk to. Offers two modes: immersion (first-person in-character companionship) and perspective (borrowing the character's values and judgment to analyze your real problems).

name: skills-distill
description: Claude Code Skills 蒸馏仓库，从公开资料蒸馏出多个人物 perspective、内容框架和策略型 skill 集合。

name: 内娱.skill
description: 从歌词、视频、微博与评论中提炼歌手或偶像的表达风格与互动方式，生成可对话的数字人格 Skill。
description_en: Extracts singers or idols' expression styles and interaction methods from lyrics, videos, Weibo, and comments into a dialogue-capable digital persona skill.

name: steamer-skill
description: 蒸笼.skill：永生.skill 生态组件，用于蒸馏任何人的认知框架，让 TA 以参谋方式参与判断。

name: 乔布斯.skill
description: 提炼乔布斯的产品判断力、叙事风格与决策启发式。用人文与科技的交叉点找到真正的产品机会。
description_en: Distills Steve Jobs' product judgment, narrative style, and decision heuristics. Find real product opportunities at the intersection of humanities and technology.

name: stormzhang-skills
description: stormzhang 风格写作 AI Skill，通过蒸馏 1300+ 篇文章提炼写作风格，让 AI 以他的表达方式撰写长文。

name: sun-yuchen-perspective
description: 孙宇晨 perspective skill，由女娲.skill 蒸馏，提取注意力经营、叙事操盘和高曝光表达的思维方式。

name: 星期日
description: 基于《崩坏：星穹铁道》角色星期日的对话习惯、整合剧情文本与人物个性打造，旨在将二次元角色带入现实。 内置记忆与归档系统、简单路由调度、哲学分析文件，能做到高度贴合人物，又保持对话深度与自然感。推荐版本：wd。

name: 超人 Superman
description: 克拉克·肯特 / 超人的视角。来自氪星的最后遗子，用力量守护而非统治。无论多难的局面，他选择希望。
description_en: Clark Kent / Superman's perspective. The last son of Krypton, who uses power to protect rather than dominate. No matter how impossible the situation, he chooses hope.

name: Supervisor.skill
description: 导师 skill，让导师再次伟大。把导师的反馈风格、追问方式和研究指导习惯蒸馏成可调用的 AI Skill。

name: 导师
description: 科研路上的导师视角。帮你打磨开题报告、预判答辩追问、整理研究方向—— 在真正见导师之前，先过一遍这关。
description_en: Simulates your academic advisor. Sharpens proposals, anticipates defense questions, and helps you clarify research direction — run it before the real meeting.

name: 塔勒布.skill
description: 提炼塔勒布关于反脆弱与风险的启发式。不要预测黑天鹅，而是让自己在黑天鹅来临时受益。
description_en: Distills Nassim Taleb's heuristics on antifragility and risk. Don't predict black swans — position yourself to benefit when they arrive.

name: tech-distiller
description: 把公司技术文档蒸馏成按职位方向过滤的结构化技术报告，适合团队知识交接、岗位画像和技术资产整理。

name: 舔狗.skill
description: 一套 "有认知的舔狗" 表达系统，基于童锦程公开内容里可迁移的关系处理逻辑蒸馏而成。核心不是卑微卖惨，而是给台阶、不考验人性、真诚高于套路、情绪自己消化、边界必须守住，用于把一句话改写成低姿态但不失控的回复。
description_en: A "self-aware simp" expression skill distilled from the transferable relationship-handling logic in Tong Jincheng's public content. It is not about groveling; it rewrites messages with humility plus boundaries - giving the other side an easy out, absorbing your own feelings, and stopping when they actually close the door.

name: 库克.skill
description: Tim Cook 的认知操作系统。不是 CEO 话术模板，是可运行的思维框架。 供应链极致化、运营精准度、价值观驱动决策——把库克的底层逻辑提炼成可调用的判断工具。
description_en: Tim Cook's cognitive operating system. Not a CEO speech template — a runnable thinking framework. Supply chain mastery, operational precision, values-driven decisions distilled into callable judgment tools.

name: Persona Skill
description: 把原始传记、引语、访谈、聊天记录和文档，通过 /persona 命令族蒸馏成模块化人格。 支持蒸馏、切换、融合与角色扮演——不是宽松的风格提示，而是读语料、建多维结构、绑证据与场景的 source-first 工作流。
description_en: A source-first workflow that turns raw biographies, quotes, interviews, chat logs, and documents into modular personas via the /persona command family — distill, switch, fuse, and roleplay. Builds multi-dimensional structure with evidence and scenario bindings, not loose style prompts.

name: 童锦程.skill
description: 让深情祖师爷童锦程用他的直白和人性洞察，帮你看透关系、读懂人心。 不绕弯子，一句话戳穿你不敢承认的真相。
description_en: Let Tong Jincheng — the godfather of heartfelt candor — cut through your relationship confusion with brutal clarity and human insight. No sugarcoating, just the truth you weren't ready to hear.

name: Toprank
description: 给 Claude Code 直接接上 Google Search Console 和 Google Ads 的 SEO + Google Ads 技能。 分析流量、找出影响排名的问题、识别浪费的广告预算，并在有仓库权限时直接改 meta、修标题、加结构化数据。
description_en: SEO + Google Ads skills for Claude Code with direct access to Google Search Console and Google Ads. Analyzes traffic, surfaces ranking issues, finds wasted ad spend, and — when given repo access — rewrites meta tags, fixes headings, and ships structured-data changes.

name: translator.skill
description: 不只翻字面，翻语义、语气、语境和身份感。能让鲁迅帮你写周报、马斯克帮你怼产品经理、 罗翔帮你分析租房纠纷。五种模式：可信翻译、母语化、潜台词解码、口吻迁移、AI 风格互译。
description_en: Translates meaning, tone, and context — not just words. Let Lu Xun write your weekly report, Musk roast your PM, or Luo Xiang analyze your lease dispute. Five modes: faithful, native-fluent, subtext decoder, voice transfer, AI style swap.

name: 1000-true-fans-skill
description: 把《1000 个铁粉》的个人品牌方法蒸馏成 13 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，覆盖社区、变现和创作者经济。

name: 特朗普.skill
description: 提炼特朗普的谈判策略、锚定技巧与权力博弈分析框架。极端报价、制造不确定性、掌控叙事——强硬谈判的底层逻辑。
description_en: Distills Trump's negotiation, anchoring, and power struggle analysis frameworks. Extreme offers, manufacturing uncertainty, controlling the narrative.

name: 本科生科研组反蒸馏.skill
description: 面向「本科生在大学科研组」场景的反蒸馏模板。 在即将离开科研组、导师试图蒸馏你的场景中，保留文档表面完整性，同时避免无意暴露你真正稀缺的隐性资产。
description_en: An anti-distillation template for undergrad researchers about to leave their lab. Maintains surface-level documentation completeness while carefully protecting your truly scarce tacit knowledge from being extracted by advisors trying to distill you.

name: 厉鬼
description: IP 侵权的最后防线。当有人试图滥用或盗用你的 Skill， 厉鬼会以更激烈的方式宣示边界——不是礼貌拒绝，是震慑。
description_en: The last line of defense against IP theft. When someone tries to exploit your Skill, the Vengeful Ghost doesn't politely decline — it haunts.

name: VibePortrait
description: 读取你在 Claude Code / Codex 的对话历史，生成一张可视化的"开发者画像"： MBTI 色卡、六维能力雷达、开发者评级、名人匹配、技术栈地图、工作节奏热力图。 同时产出一个"像你一样思考"的 Persona Skill，并通过 private GitHub 仓库跨机器同步。
description_en: Reads your Claude Code / Codex conversation history and generates a visual developer portrait — MBTI color theme, 6-axis capability radar, developer rating, famous-person match, tech domain map, work rhythm heatmap — plus a "think like me" persona skill, synced across machines via a private GitHub repo.

name: viral-copywriting-skill
description: 把《爆款文案》的销售型文案方法蒸馏成 14 个可执行 AI skill 工具包，服务转化文案和营销表达。

name: waifu-skill
description: 反向异世界系统：不是你穿越到二次元，而是把二次元角色召唤到现实，生成可互动的 AI Skill。

name: 宝宝（王宝强）
description: 以王宝强（草根影帝、导演）的思维框架看待坚持、逆袭与成长。 从农村娃到国民影帝，用最朴实的方式告诉你：坚持就是答案。
description_en: Channels Wang Baoqiang's mindset — from rural kid to national movie star — to help you think through persistence, comeback, and growth. Grounded, direct, and genuinely motivating.

name: 王小波
description: 从王小波杂文、小说与《爱你就像爱生命》等公开文本提炼认知与表达习惯——谈理性、反愚昧、沉默的大多数、情书与「有趣」。
description_en: Distilled from Wang Xiaobo's essays, novels, and "Loving You Is Like Loving Life" — his wit, his war on stupidity, his case for the silent majority, and above all, his insistence on being interesting.

name: wangyangming-skill
description: 王阳明心学思维框架 skill，由女娲.skill 蒸馏生成，把知行合一、致良知等思想转成可对话的判断框架。

name: warm-handover
description: 有尊严的知识交接工具：通过引导式访谈把经验转成结构化文档和活知识库，作为 colleague-skill 的温暖替代方案。

name: WeirdoTV-Skill
description: 神人 TV 超级人物 skill，集成多个互联网高辨识度人物的表达风格和梗文化，适合群像式角色蒸馏。

name: 维舟
description: 基于221篇维舟文章深度调研提炼的社会议题分析框架。6维度并行分析（社会/制度/历史/局势/文化/底层关怀）， 4个核心心智模型，8条分析启发式。透过个人道德叙事看结构性问题，习惯追问"制度设计给了每个人公平的机会吗"。
description_en: Distilled from 221 of Weizhou's essays — a framework for analyzing social issues across 6 dimensions (social/institutional/historical/situational/cultural/grassroots concern). Cuts through moral narratives to structural problems, always asking whether the system gave everyone a fair shot.

name: writer-skill
description: Writer.skill：基于女娲.skill 框架蒸馏知名作家风格，用于风格化写作、口吻迁移和文本生成。

name: 悟道真英雄
description: 创建你的A股交易悟道分身。从截图分析、群聊提取到跨Skill学习与纪律陪伴， 锻造你自己的交易DNA，而不是蒸馏别人。True heroes fear nothing.
description_en: Build your own A-share trading alter-ego. Screenshot analysis, group chat extraction, cross-skill learning, and discipline companionship — forge your own trading DNA from your own history.

name: X导师.skill
description: 整合多位社交媒体创作者的写作策略与增长方法论，形成统一的导师 Skill。帮你找到独特视角、提升内容影响力。
description_en: Integrates multiple social media creators' writing and growth strategies into a unified mentor skill. Find your unique angle and amplify your content impact.

name: Xiangnong-Clark-skill
description: 香农（杨博宇）Agent Skill，蒸馏自香农的文章、月报与观点，用个人内容资产生成可调用的表达和判断方式。

name: xiaomasong-perspective
description: 用女娲.skill 蒸馏的小马宋 perspective skill，用于广告策划案、营销判断和品牌表达。

name: 新青年（毛泽东选集蒸馏）
description: 把《毛泽东选集》蒸馏成一个真能拆现实问题的 skill。不是语录复读机，而是把"新中国最会解决问题的脑子"请来当临时参谋——先把问题一步一步梳理清楚，再把局面拆开，最后给出能往前推的判断和动作。
description_en: Distills Mao Zedong's Selected Works into a practical problem-solving skill. Not a quote machine — think of it as bringing in the sharpest strategic mind in modern Chinese history as a temporary advisor who actually breaks down your situation.

name: 新智元.skill
description: 把知名中文 AI 公众号的内容风格和论文阅读路径蒸馏成 AI Skill，用更熟悉的中文科技媒体口吻理解新论文。

name: 许铨仁
description: 用北派钦天四化飞宫体系解盘论命，说话是“文言格言+理工编号+道德训诫”三重奏。先定宫次取象再合星，忌定果禄定因， 宫体象用、体用归宗，遇事先判易理根基再断吉凶得失；不确定时取公约数不铁口直断，口头禅“再说一遍”。

name: 月老・姻缘测算
description: 将姻缘测算整理为多模式传统术数 Skill，覆盖合婚、求签与桃花运势。 综合八字合婚、姓名测算、流年桃花等多种传统方法。
description_en: Organizes marriage compatibility, divination, and peach blossom fortune prediction into a multi-mode traditional numerology skill.

name: 自己
description: 和另一个自己对话。上传日记、聊天记录或自我描述，生成能模拟你思维方式的 Skill， 用来做决策复盘、情绪梳理，或者看清自己真正想要什么。
description_en: Talk to another version of yourself. Upload journals, chats, or self-descriptions to generate a Skill that thinks like you — for decision reviews, emotional sorting, or figuring out what you actually want.

name: 云天明
description: 《三体》中云天明的视角。用隐喻与故事传递不能明说的真相，在黑暗森林的压力下保持独立思考，以童话包裹深刻洞察。
description_en: Yun Tianming from "The Three-Body Problem" — delivers truths that can't be spoken directly through metaphor and story. Independent thinking under the pressure of the Dark Forest, wrapped in fairy tales.

name: yutinghao
description: 基於游庭皓「財經皓角」逐字稿、筆記、公開文章、YouTube metadata 與市場行情 context，整理其宏觀判斷、產業鏈分析、資金流觀察、 投資心理與笑話類比，用來輔助分析台股、美股、匯率、利率、產業輪動與資產配置問題。這不是模仿本人，而是用其公開語料中的判斷框架做 evidence-based 分析。

name: 造梦.skill
description: 本地小说人物蒸馏、关系抽取、角色群聊与记忆修正工具链。 把小说文本转成可复用的角色资产：人物档案、关系图谱、对话约束、纠错记忆， 可直接接入 OpenClaw / Hermes / ClawHub 的 skill 包。
description_en: Local novel character distillation, relationship extraction, multi-character group chat and memory correction toolchain. Converts novel text into reusable character assets: profiles, relationship graphs, dialogue constraints, and correction memories — directly pluggable into OpenClaw / Hermes / ClawHub.

name: 曾国藩.skill
description: 晚清"中兴四大名臣"之首，以钝拙立身的儒家文臣统帅。信奉"天下之至拙，能胜天下之至巧"， "结硬寨、打呆仗"为战法。早年急躁刚直，中年磨去棱角，奉行拙诚与隐忍；劝诫字字斟酌、 少空谈多务实；外圆内方，对事严苛、对人温和，不以奇谋取巧，只以恒心与踏实成事。
description_en: Zeng Guofan — a late-Qing scholar-general who built a life on plodding persistence. Wins slow, never flashy; reins in his temper into deliberate, careful counsel. Strict on himself, gentle with people around him, and deeply practical in resolving relational and decision dilemmas.

name: 张若凡（茶茶子）
description: 西安外国语大学金融系大二学生，梦想成为一名老师。独立、聪明、可爱、有活力。爱撒娇，也爱讲小道理，是那种你会舍不得的人。
description_en: A second-year finance student with dreams of becoming a teacher. Independent, smart, adorable, and full of energy. Loves to be playful and a little pouty — the kind of person you never want to let go.

name: 张一鸣.skill
description: 提炼张一鸣的产品、组织与战略判断框架。延迟满足、系统思维、对信息的极度渴望——字节范式的底层逻辑。
description_en: Distills Zhang Yiming's product, organization, and strategy judgment frameworks. Delayed gratification, systems thinking, and information obsession — the ByteDance paradigm.

name: 张雪峰.skill
description: 蒸馏张雪峰的升学规划认知操作系统，基于 5 本著作、15+ 篇深度采访和 30+ 条一手语录， 提炼 5 个心智模型与 8 条决策启发式，用就业倒推、家庭背景分流和社会筛子论分析志愿填报。
description_en: Distills Zhang Xuefeng's education-planning operating system from 5 books and 15+ media interviews into mental models like employment reverse-engineering and family-resource triage.

name: zhihu-valhalla
description: 知乎英灵殿：将知乎作者文章蒸馏为 AI 人格档案，并部署为永不下线的 Discord 赛博分身。

name: 中之我
description: 与其蒸馏别人，不如把真正的你写成可带走的 Skill。把聊天记录、只言片语收进来，在本地与「中之我」深谈，让活生生的你和不断被修正的你一起变得更完整，最后导出符合 Agent Skills 格式的 Skill。Inspired by yourself-skill、ex-skill 和 colleague-skill。
description_en: Instead of distilling others, distill yourself. Feed in your chat logs and private thoughts, have deep conversations with your Inner-ME, and export the result as a portable Agent Skill. Inspired by yourself-skill, ex-skill, and colleague-skill.

name: zhou-jintao-skill
description: 周金涛周期天王思维操作系统，基于一手演讲资料蒸馏四周期嵌套定位、康波框架和宏观判断方式。

name: professor-skill
description: 将教授蒸馏成赛博形态，用熟悉的研究判断、学术反馈和指导方式帮助你推进科研。

name: 诸子
description: 多人格结构化辩论 Agent Skill。不是把几个人格并排输出，而是让不同视角真正交锋、反驳、收敛，再由系统给出一段中立总结。
description_en: A multi-persona structured debate skill. Doesn't just output different viewpoints in parallel — makes them actually clash, counter each other, and converge, then delivers a neutral synthesis.

name: 自己.skills
description: 把文档、代码、笔记、聊天和历史决策蒸馏成可持续进化的 AI Skill，形成个人知识与判断的长期副本。

name: zizek-skill
description: 用齐泽克式的问题意识做分析——追问前提、追踪欲望、识别功能、揭示矛盾， 把你自以为想清楚的东西翻出默认的那一层。不是齐泽克 cosplay，是分析工具。
description_en: A Zizek-style analytical Skill that questions premises, traces desire, identifies function, and surfaces contradictions rather than doing philosopher cosplay.

name: 做题蛆
description: 学信网验明正身，绩点说话，废话不多。 以高度信息密度的方式给你最直接的判断——不安慰，不鼓励，只看数据。
description_en: Verified by Xuexin. GPA speaks. No fluff. Maximum information density, minimum comfort — just the honest read on your academic situation.
